reforms.description: The Canadian government introduced measures to stimulate immediate employment opportunities and long-term economic growth, including a larger programme of assistance to municipalities for winter work projects and incentives for urban renewal.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: The measures aim to create jobs and stimulate economic growth, which supports overall productivity and allocative efficiency.
reforms.status_evidence: The measures have been put into action to stimulate employment and growth.
reforms.importance_rationale: The reform is significant as it involves a larger programme of assistance, but it is not a structural change.
reforms.source_quote: The first set of measures included another and larger programme of assistance to municipalities for winter work projects, another special winter housing programme, and incentives for urban renewal and slum clearance.

reforms.description: The Canadian government announced changes to income tax regulations to assist small businesses, including capital depreciation allowances at double the normal rate in the first year to encourage investment.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: The tax changes are designed to encourage investment in small businesses, which can lead to increased productivity and innovation.
reforms.status_evidence: The changes to income tax regulations have been enacted to support small businesses.
reforms.importance_rationale: The reform is significant as it provides targeted support for small businesses, but it does not represent a major overhaul of the tax system.
reforms.source_quote: Income tax regulations were changed in order to assist small business, and capital depreciation allowances at double the normal rate in the first year were to be used to encourage firms to invest in designated areas.
